offers.note: Git tag archive of yt-dlp 2026.10.26 (RELEASE_GIT_HEAD c91f8de0bfb3577894abad716eaaa01659e6bd14). This is the tree the release binaries are built from. It contains bundle/pyinstaller.py, hashed bundle/requirements, uv.lock, and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt. The smaller yt-dlp.tar.gz sdist on the same release omits those build files, so it is not the offer.
offers.reason: Linux bundles still include unpinned GPL/LGPL libraries (GNU Readline, libintl, libidn2, libunistring). libstdc++ and libgcc are GPL-3.0-with-GCC-exception and are not a GCC source duty. The complete flag is not a publish input.

bundledSources.name: PyInstaller
bundledSources.note: COPYING.txt Bootloader Exception allows embedding the bootloader in a combined executable. bundle/requirements/pyinstaller.txt already hashes this sdist, and the archive contains bootloader/src, so the kit includes it.

bundledSources.name: GNU Readline
bundledSources.reason: THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt marks it Linux-only. The license URL is an unpinned upstream tree.

bundledSources.name: libintl
bundledSources.reason: Linux-only. The license URL tracks gettext master, not a commit.

bundledSources.name: libidn2
bundledSources.reason: Linux-only. The license URL tracks libidn2 master.

bundledSources.name: libunistring
bundledSources.reason: Linux-only. The license URL tracks HEAD.

offers.note: BtbN autobuild-2026-11-07-12-47. addins/9.0.sh sets GIT_BRANCH=release/9.0. The shipped asset names encode d4070a14ce, which resolves to d4070a14cecc7e29eb278f9b6036c2284255f70d (2026-11-06). Every scripts.d stage in that tag has SCRIPT_COMMIT or SCRIPT_REV. Those pins are listed here and are checked again against the build-script archive before a release is packed.
offers.reason: GitHub commit archives are pinned when the tree contains a license file (78 dependencies). nv-codec-headers has no license file in that commit. Non-GitHub pins (Videolan, GitLab, Savannah, SourceForge, SVN) are not fetched. ffbuild_enabled skips fdk-aac for gpl, whisper unconditionally, and libcurl when ffver <= 900. The complete flag is not a publish input.

The fetch URL redirect/latest/macos/{arm64,amd64}/release currently returns the 9.0.2 zips from 2026-09-20. Their versions.txt lists harfbuzz 14.4.0 and x264 0.165.x. git.martin-riedl.de/ffmpeg/build-script has no tags. Branch main (2026-08-17) pins ffmpeg 9.0.1 and harfbuzz 14.3.0, which is not this binary. script/build-x264.sh downloads the floating archive x264-master.tar.gz and there is no version/x264 file.

The v0.41.0 release assets are the binaries only. Job macos for macos-14-arm runs brew update and brew install ffmpeg libplacebo libass without matrix.homebrew, so the bundled libraries are not pinned. ci/build-win32.ps1 clones shaderc with --depth 1 and builds vulkan-loader with UPDATE_DEPS=ON after meson wrap update-db. The mpv tag is the player source, not the corresponding source of those binaries.
